title: Asked to work on electron flow for back-engineering

tellings.quote: I know they were working on it a long time ago because I was asked to to work on which way electrons move.

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, who says UFOs appear around him and who the episode says is studied by NASA, says he was once asked to work out which way electrons move. He tells it first-hand, as proof that people were trying to copy alien technology long ago.
